ms.promise:
(A) Front-end platform: design of the web platform for interaction with the user. Will be developed in NodeJS, using the best front-end web development practices and hosted on Vercel.
(B) Back-end platform: creation of the administration panel for managing users, transactions and financial information. The back-end will be developed in NodeJS integrated with APIs to connect the system with other solution providers.
(C) Payment gateway: integration with the payment gateway that will send and receive bank transactions, following our safety criteria, security, reliability, integration and adapted to the local Brazilian market.
(D) KYC Provider: integration with the KYC (Know Your Customer) platform. There are a number of KYC solution providers in the Brazilian market, we will opt for the best cost/benefit ratio that delivers the levels of security, privacy and confirmability with the project requirements.
(E) Cardano blockchain: integration with the Cardano wallet for sending and receiving ADA transactions. We will integrate with the Cardano blockchain resources, either through Cardano Node, or using the send and receive resources of the Cardano Wallet, and information provided by Blo
